verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a client app with no evidence of exposing its own documented public API; the probe for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec at docs.github.com returned 404s, and the docs pack only markets Copilot features, not programmatic API access to the mobile app itself. missing for 10: any documented REST/GraphQL/OpenAPI spec for driving GitHub Mobile, SDKs, or automation endpoints tied to this product.
